country.webp.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent bakery campaign hero cutout, landscape 3:2 composition.
Primary request: Create one original premium contemporary food campaign photograph of a whole large flour-dusted rustic round sourdough loaf, with one bold diagonal score across its crown, plus one generous torn piece at the lower right revealing a beautifully open irregular crumb. The torn piece belongs to this same loaf.
Scene/backdrop: No backdrop, isolated on genuine transparent alpha.
Style/medium: Ultra-real photographic food still life, tactile honest baked crust, naturally irregular artisan bread, luxurious commercial bakery campaign quality.
Composition/framing: Overhead three-quarter camera, entire loaf and torn piece fully in frame with generous breathing room; bread group fills about 75% of landscape 3:2 canvas. Slight diagonal energetic composition. Clear silhouette and sharp fine edge detail.
Lighting/mood: Hard-soft directional studio daylight from upper-left, warm golden crust with neutral highlights and deep natural toasted shadows, realistic dimensional volume.
Materials/textures: Flour dust on rugged caramelized crust, crisp blistered surface, moist cream-colored open crumb with convincing irregular holes, tiny torn bread fibres.
Constraints: Exactly this loaf and torn bread piece only. No props, no plates, no hands, no cutlery, no labels, no text, no logo, no watermark. True transparent background. Do not render a checkerboard, white field, colored backdrop, rectangular shadow area, or baked-in vignette. At most a tiny natural contact shadow immediately beneath bread; the surrounding canvas must be fully transparent.
country.webp.optimization: sharp 0.35.5, WebP quality88 alpha100, no visual alteration
